title: Chapter 423 Defeat Liu Hong
content:
Chapter 423 Defeat Liu Hong

"Send a message to the leader of Tan Lang immediately, and ask him to join us in attacking this rash enemy army."

He said to the messenger, and asked the maid to put on armor for him, intending to go and see for himself which blind guy dared to attack his base camp.

At this time, Wang Shuo had led a hundred thousand troops and circled behind Liu Hong, forming a pincer attack on him.

Liu Hong never dreamed that the army of Dahuai Domain would dare to fight him under the city wall.

At this time, Zhao Bangde had also personally taken action and led a group of masters to kill down the city wall.

Countless ropes were hung upside down from the city wall, and soldiers slid down from them continuously.

The offensive of the attackers was immediately frustrated and was defeated.

Liu Hong was surprised to see the vanguard army retreat.

Does the other side want to fight to the death?

Do they not care about the monsters on the opposite side?

"Messenger, where are our monster allies?"

At this time, a panting soldier hurriedly reported.

"Lord, the monsters have withdrawn."

When Liu Hong heard this, he seemed to have lost all his energy and spirit, and he retreated a few steps dejectedly.

"No wonder the other side dared to confront me head-on. It seems that there is no worry."

At this moment, Liu Hong also had the idea of retreating.

The number of top masters in Dahuai Domain far exceeds that of himself, and he is definitely not going to win.

Just when Liu Hong was panicking, Wang Shuo had already rushed over with the cavalry.

Although Liu Hong is also a high-level general, he has not fought in person for a long time.

Seeing the enemy cavalry with great momentum, coming fiercely.

He hurriedly took a few confidants and fled to the side.

The defeat was like a mountain collapsing.

Without the command of the general, the bloodthirsty army was like a pile of loose sand, and each fled for his life.

The boss has run away, why fight, your life is your own.

"No killing for surrender."

On the battlefield, all the soldiers of the Dahuai Territory shouted in unison.

The soldiers of the bloodthirsty legion put down their weapons in groups and raised their hands above their heads.

Liu Hong looked back and a burst of anger instantly rushed to his head.

"The beast is really unreliable!"

At this time, he hated both the Dahuai Territory and the Demon King.

This time, he would definitely uproot these two forces.

Wang Shuo saw the enemy's main general escape, so how could he give up this opportunity.

Immediately, he took Ayub and other generals to open the acceleration formation, and took the Golden Fire Cavalry and the Hell Knights to chase the fleeing enemy.

Wang Shuo learned a lot of formations in the War General Tower, and the number and level were not comparable to Ayub and others.

Soon, Wang Shuo caught up with Liu Hong.

"Iron-blooded Lord, huh!?"

Liu Hong looked at Wang Shuo with a sadistic smile on his face, his face heavy.

Who would have thought that the insignificant little character would grow up to be a mid-level general and organize such a large cavalry unit.

"What do you want? If you let me go today, I promise that I will never invade the Dahuai Territory."

Liu Hong said solemnly.

He still didn't understand the situation at all.

Wang Shuo had to remind him politely: "Lord Tiexue, first of all, I remind you that you are now surrounded. If nothing unexpected happens, you should not be able to escape."

"Secondly, your territory should be under attack from major forces such as the Wagliang Empire, Qingyang City, and Sunset City."

"I'm afraid that your territory will be divided up soon."
